name: concept journal
wording: the project's append-only record of its design and decisions, kept with the project and starting empty: the current design, every history and the open decisions are computed from it, the latest version of a concept or context description being current and two versions superseding the same one competing until a later one supersedes both, so nothing else is an account of the design. A cut's entries are added on its branch and arrive with its merge; it warns, never refuses, where wording names an implementation instead of what must hold; and with the ledger it makes up the project's one event-sourced record, the design stream beside the work stream, every view computed from them, with the examples kept beside the record as documents.
reason: The record's event-sourced shape is current meaning a fresh session needs; the restatement had dropped it.
